mainEntity.name: How does Hometelligent Inc. manage project budgets to avoid cost overruns?

acceptedAnswer.text: We manage project budgets through detailed initial estimates, continuous cost monitoring, and proactive identification of potential financial risks. Any proposed changes are discussed with the client and documented to ensure transparency. This meticulous approach helps prevent unexpected expenses and keeps the project within the agreed financial framework.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hometelligent manages project budgets with detailed estimates, continuous monitoring, and proactive risk identification, ensuring transparency and preventing overruns.
